title: symplocos crassipes var. brandiana
intro: Symplocos crassipes var. brandiana, commonly known as the Philippine alstonia or brandiana symplocos, is a plant species belonging to the Symplocaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including the potential treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of S. crassipes var. brandiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been isolated and studied for their medicinal properties.
